title: Set a shared study time
description: Pick a regular time to study together and encourage reading and curiosity.
source: United Nations — SDG 4 and SDG 5 targets

title: Swap books and help with digital skills
description: Exchange learning materials and help a family member practice digital skills.
source: United Nations — SDG 4 and SDG 5 targets

title: Share chores fairly
description: Divide household chores fairly and challenge comments that limit activities by gender.
source: United Nations — SDG 4 and SDG 5 targets

title: Listen respectfully
description: When family members describe unfair treatment, listen respectfully.
source: United Nations — SDG 4 and SDG 5 targets

title: Talk about rights and learning
description: Discuss reliable information about rights and learning opportunities.
source: United Nations — SDG 4 and SDG 5 targets

title: Organize peer tutoring
description: Start peer tutoring, a book or stationery exchange or an inclusive study group, with accessible notes.
source: UNESCO — SDG 4 monitoring; United Nations — SDG 5 targets

title: Challenge stereotypes
description: Question stereotypes about subjects, sports and careers, and learn the school's anti-harassment reporting steps.
source: UNESCO — SDG 4 monitoring; United Nations — SDG 5 targets

title: Propose inclusive activities
description: Make sure students with different needs can take part. Take serious safety concerns to a trusted adult or the school authority.
source: UNESCO — SDG 4 monitoring; United Nations — SDG 5 targets

title: Volunteer with a verified library
description: Volunteer, or donate usable books through a trusted organization.
source: UNICEF — education; UN Women — leadership and participation

title: Support safe, equal participation
description: Back community initiatives for safety, equal participation and women's leadership. Share verified information about local support services.
source: UNICEF — education; UN Women — leadership and participation

title: Check before you organize
description: Consult established organizations first, respect privacy and get consent before photographing or publishing anyone.
source: UNICEF — education; UN Women — leadership and participation

title: Share credible resources
description: Share free learning resources and scholarships only after checking eligibility, dates and the official source.
source: UNESCO — media and information literacy; UN Women

title: Challenge stereotypes kindly
description: Challenge stereotypes without harassment, amplify credible work by women and girls, and report abusive content.
source: UNESCO — media and information literacy; UN Women

title: Pause before you post
description: Check the original source, note the publication year, avoid sharing personal information and use respectful language.
source: UNESCO — media and information literacy; UN Women
